content: Dule-Bab-Dummadga-san-uksamalad-igar
Bab-Jehová Moisésʼga sunmakded, ega sogded:

“Israel-dulemarga be sunmak, ega be soge: ‘Machered-gwensak-sokardibe, igi, ome-gwensak-sokardibe, Bab-Jehováʼgarbi an ibmar-imakdii guega Bab-Jehováʼga bela an-san an na ukoye, we-dule Nazareoʼye soglegoed.

Deyob na imakele, vino gobosulid, degi, sisamar gobosurbalid. Deginbali, vinagre-vinoʼgi-danikid, degi, vinagre-sisamargi-danikid, gobosurbalid. Deginbali, uva-nis gobosurbalid, degine, uvaʼmar, degi uva-odinnolegarmalad gunnosurbalid.
Dule Nazareoʼga-gudiid-ibagangine, e-ibagan-sogsad-berguedse bipisaale, uva-san, e-gwag, degi, e-ukase-bakale, gunnosulid.

” ’Ar dule na Nazareoʼga-gudiidgine, e-ibagan-sogsad-berguedse sailagia sikosulid. Unnila Bab-Jehováʼgarbi-ibmar-imakdii guoed, degine, e-sailagia suitii imakoed, ar ade, e-sailagia sikosulid. Geb ibagan-bergunonikile, a-sorba, sunna na e-sailagia sikoed.
” ’A-ukinbali, a-dule Bab-Jehováʼga na-san-uksad-ibagangine, dule-burgwaledse warmakosurbalid.

Amba e-babdibe, igi, e-nan burgwisdibe, igi, e-urbadibe, igi, e-ia-burgwisdibe, igi, e-bundibe, ase-bakale, ese warmakosulid, ar ade, Bab-Jehováʼgarbi-ibmar-imakdiguega Bab-Jehováʼga na san-uksa gudiid.
Dule Bab-Jehováʼga na san-uksad-ibagangine, unnila Bab-Jehováʼgarbi ibmar-imakdii guoed.

” ’Dule-Bab-Jehováʼga-na-san-uksad-walik, dule-wargwen ukiar burgwenonikile, we-dule-Nazareoʼga-gudiid-e-igar-maid oichogoed. Degisoggu, ibagugledgi (7), na san-uruked-e-ibagan-mosale, non-swirii imakoed.
Degine, ibabaabakadgi (8) sapur-nuu-gwabo, igi, wagnuu-e-mimmi-gwabodibe, sedagoed. Bab-Dummad-dulemarbo-ambikued-neg-yawagakse, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goledse sedagoed.

” ’Ar dule-Bab-Jehováʼga-na-san-uksad, dule-burgwisad-ular isgunonisoggu, we-nuu-gwabo-ukoedi, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goled, we-nuu-gwagwen dule-isgued-osulogega Bab-Dummadga ukoed. Nuu-baiddi, ogumakar Bab-Dummadga ukbaloed. A-ibagangine, gannar na e-sailagia osuguoed, Bab-Dummadga sogegar, gannar an bega an-san ukbarye.

Geb degi, we-dule Bab-Jehováʼga-na-san-uksad-ibagangi, Bab-Jehováʼgarbi nanadii guoed. E-isgusad-ular, sibad-wawaad-sapingwagwad-birgagwen-nikad Bab-Dummadga sedagoed, adi, e-isgusad ega osulogegar. Idu Bab-Jehováʼgarbi-arbadigusad-ibagan bar ebislegosulid. Ar dule-burgwisadi, ei ibagan oichossoggu, e-ibagan gannar onodoed.
” ’Weyobi, dule-Nazareoʼga-gudiid e-ibagan-sogsad bergunonikile, ega-igar-maidba imakoed. Bab-Dummad-dulemarbo-ambikued-neg-yawagakse na dagoed.
Agi, Bab-Jehováʼga ibmar-ukleged sedagoed:

content.text: We-sibad-wawaad swilidik, gwen boni-nikasuli ogumakar-uklegega senonikoed.
Degine, sibad-wawaad-ome-birgagwen-nikad-swilidikid, gwen boni-nikasulid, e-isgued-anar ukega senonibaloed.
Deginbali, Nazareo-dule ibmar-gwag-Bab-Jehováʼga-ukleged, degine, e-gobed-ega-uklebalid, sedabaloed.

content: ” ’Geb degine, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goled, we-Nazareo-dulega-isgued-osulogega, we-ibmar Bab-Jehováʼga ukoed. A-ukinbali, we-ibmar ogumakar Bab-Jehováʼga ukbaloed.

Deginbali, gwenatigwar-guega, sibad-wawaad-machered oburgwebaloed. We-sibad-wawaadba-mesa garba-bipigi-madu-inasuli-bukwad dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goled Bab-Jehováʼga ukbaloed. Deginbali, ibmar-gwagmar, degi, ibmar-eolemalad Bab-Jehováʼga ukbaloed.

” ’Geb degidgine, dule-na-Bab-Jehováʼga-san-uksad, Bab-Dummad-dulemarbo ambikued-neg-e-yawagak-walik na-e-sailagia ioed. Geb agine, e-sailagia soogi-ogumakega Bab-Dummadga-ibmar-uklenaid-urba soo-gasiidgi urboed. We-ibmarde gwenatigwar-guega uklenaid.

” ’Dule-Bab-Jehováʼga-san-uksad-sailagia-siksad-sorbali, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goled sibad-wawaad-machered-e-gukin-matar-dualed suoed, degine, garbagi madu-olo-inasulid-siid, madu-matar-e-inasulid-siid subaloed. Agi, geb Nazareo-dulega ukoed.

Geb we-ibmar-ukoedi, gannar suoed. Geb dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goled, bana-bana-imakar Bab-Jehováʼga ukoed. We-ibmar dule geg yogasaar sued, unnila dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goledga uklegoed. Deginbali, sibad-wawaad-e-binasgar, degi, e-dua Bab-Jehováʼga-uklearbalid dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goledga uklebaloed. Geb deyobi, a-sorbali, dule-Bab-Jehováʼga-na-san-uksad, sunna vino-gobe gunonisunnoed.

” ’Dule Bab-Jehováʼga-san-uksad-Nazareoʼye-bileged Bab-Jehováʼgarbi-ibmar-imakdigubiele, weyob ega igar-mai guoed. Weyobi, Bab-Jehováʼga ibmar-ukoed, degi, na ibmar-nikadba ukbaloed. Dule-Bab-Jehováʼga-na-san-urmaksadi igar-maidba na imakergebed, imaksuli guosulid, imakedsegad.’ ”
Bab-Dummad-dulemargi-nued-binsaed-igar
Bab-Jehová Moisésʼga sunmakdebalid, ega sogdebalid:
“Aarónʼga, degi, e-masmalaga be sunmak. Ega be soge: ‘Israel-dulemargi ise-nued be sunmakalile, weyobi, be sogoed:

content.text: Degi, ulubgi bogidikid bega ukdii gusun.’

content: ”Weyobi Aarón, degi, e-masmala, Israel-dulemarga an-nuggi sogoed. Geb degine, Israel-dulemargi nued an binsaoed.”
